resources.string: Official Media3 demo: Tears of Steel (Widevine CENC). Streams from Google’s public test service; no account or Crunchyroll connection. Uses mobile data if Wi-Fi is unavailable.
Tears of Steel: English audio and no subtitles. Sintel Widevine: multiple subtitle languages and alternate audio representations for track-switching validation.
